name: dsh-multi-agent-harness
description: DSH plugin that registers the 16 agent presets (15 role-* specialists + orchestrator) directly from this repo's agents/ + orchestrator/ files with the agent-preset registry. Replaces dsh-agent-preset-roster; no .agent-presets/ deployment copy. Since DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 the orchestrator reaches a role by selecting its preset through the delegation tool's agent_preset argument; the per-instance persona/toolFilter config keys no longer exist.
